Press Release


Maase Inc. Signs RMB14.76 Million AI Computing Services Contract, Further Expanding Enterprise AI Infrastructure Services


September 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT


QINGDAO, China, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Maase Inc. (NASDAQ: MAAS) (“[MAAS](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rnN2dPDxJPoklN5zJTEFnA6VlzeBg60eube8NFr68K9igKgjyCBfVMUzB00loh2UIwUnj34MxZqQbmnNGRZqzQ==) ” or the “Company”), an artificial intelligence (“AI”)-centric full-scene digital systems provider and operator, today announced that recently, its subsidiary, Huarong Future (Sichuan) Technology Co., Ltd. (“Huarong Future”), entered into a computing services agreement (the “Agreement”) with Guangzhou Chuangyan Information Technology Co., Ltd. (“Guangzhou Chuangyan”). The Agreement has a total contract value of RMB14.76 million and a 12-month term.


Under the Agreement, Huarong Future will provide Guangzhou Chuangyan with 90P-class FP16 computing capacity, together with related technical consulting and support, as well as troubleshooting services for the underlying hardware and system layers of the computing equipment and platform. Guangzhou Chuangyan will pay a monthly computing services fee of RMB1.23 million for 12 months, for a total contract value of RMB14.76 million.


The Agreement defines technical standards for delivery. Under non-sparse computing conditions, the aggregate theoretical peak FP16 half-precision floating-point performance of the computing cluster is required to exceed 90P.


Dr. Zhifeng Li, Chief Technology Officer of MAAS, said: “Our cooperation with Guangzhou Chuangyan demonstrates MAAS's execution capabilities in translating computing resource integration into enterprise-level services. As AI model training, AI inference and enterprise AI applications continue to expand, demand is growing for computing resources that are stable, scalable and supported by ongoing technical services. Looking ahead, MAAS will continue to strengthen its capabilities in computing resource integration, technical delivery and operational services, while advancing its AI infrastructure business from project-based delivery toward a more continuous computing services model.”


**About MAAS**


Maase Inc. (NASDAQ: MAAS) is an integrated provider and operator of an artificial intelligence (“AI”) -centric full-scene digital systems. The Company’s businesses focus on areas of flexible energy deployment and intelligent commercial network operation, and provide closed-loop solutions from computing infrastructure, smart hardware and full-scene services, aiming to achieve large-scale implementation of AI technologies across industries. Powered by its dual engines of intelligent technology and ecosystem integration, through strategic industry consolidation and continuous improvement in operations, the Company’s mission is to build up an open and collaborative industrial ecosystem and provide customers with efficient, reliable and sustainable intelligent products and solutions. The Company will continuously explore and consolidate high-quality technological and commercial resources globally and explore industrial application scenarios of AI technologies. For more information, please visit: *https://ir.maaseai.com/* .
